endorsements.quote: Establishing independent ethics boards to oversee system development and deployment, conducting multicenter randomized controlled trials, and creating clear regulatory frameworks will ensure safe and effective implementation.
The governance and oversight of health care AI systems requires a multistakeholder approach with clear lines of responsibility and accountability .
Extensive research and itera tive design processes, with direct input from HCPs, are essential for successful integra tion.

unlisted_practices: Health care organizations should maintain transparent policies about AI use.
Health care organizations should establish mechanisms for patient feedback and grievance resolution regarding AI.
Health care organizations should implement rigorous data validation processes and interoperability standards.
Health care organizations should develop hybrid models that balance sophisticated AI capabilities with interpretable techniques.
